title: Open 13.5
creator: CrossFit Games
description: Four-minute AMRAP of 15 thrusters at 100/65 lb and 15 chest-to-bar pull-ups. Finish three rounds (90 reps) inside 4 minutes and the clock extends to 8; keep clearing 90 reps per window and it extends to 12 and 16. Masters 55+ used 65/45 lb with chin-over-bar or jumping pull-ups.

items.name: AMRAP 4 (+4)
items.note: Complete 3 rounds (90 reps) before 4:00 and the cap extends to 8:00; 180 reps before 8:00 extends to 12:00; 270 before 12:00 extends to 16:00.
